maintenance_items.label: Gearbox / transmission oil
maintenance_items.description: Change the independent gearbox oil that lubricates the clutch and gears, separate from engine combustion.

maintenance_items.label: 2T mix / injection oil
maintenance_items.description: Top up the two-stroke oil tank (if auto-lube) or accurately mix manually into petrol, typically 1.5%–2.5%.

maintenance_items.label: Spark plug
maintenance_items.description: Prone to carbon fouling and oil bridges. Inspect, clean, or replace much more frequently than 4T.

maintenance_items.label: Piston & rings
maintenance_items.description: High wear item. Measure cylinder clearance, replace piston rings and piston to prevent severe loss of compression or seizure.

maintenance_items.label: Exhaust power valve
maintenance_items.description: Dismantle and clean heavy carbon and soot deposits to ensure smooth operational opening at high revs.

maintenance_items.label: Silencer packing (fiber)
maintenance_items.description: Replace internal fiberglass packing inside the silencer to maintain correct backpressure and exhaust noise limits.
